summary: Hillsborough County tower called Valrico: named in a 1950 observation-tower list, a 1983 survey description and 1980 county photos; no build date or fate found.

events.note: A Tampa Tribune list of county observation towers names a Valrico tower on Road 60, with W.O. Weeks as towerman.
County photograph dated 1980 is titled as a view from the Valrico fire tower, facing northwest.
Hillsborough County described the National Geodetic Survey station named Valrico Fire Lookout Tower (survey data sheet).

notes_for_editor: The 1950 towerman list, the NGS station and the 1980 county photos are not shown to describe the same structure. The NGS sheet places its station 2.7 miles southeast of Valrico; the county places the photographed tower north of State Road 60 and west of Sydney Washer Road. Status, height, build date and fate are unknown. Two WebSearch queries found nothing more. No new photos added because licence terms were not checked. Story is 146 words, above the 120-word floor.
